trig.title: Trigonometry
trig.rightHint: Enter two values including at least one side. The right angle is at vertex C. a is opposite α, b is opposite β.
trig.needMore: Enter at least two values including one side (and valid values).
trig.obliqueHint: Enter three values including at least one side. Side a is opposite angle A, and so on.
trig.ambiguous: The data gives two possible triangles.
trig.needMoreOblique: Not enough data or the triangle does not exist. Enter three values including one side.

holes.title: Bolt holes and counterbores
holes.head: Head / part type
holes.noHeadSize: No dimensions for {{head}} in size {{size}}. Choose another size or "Custom dimensions".
holes.plateHint: Enter the plate thickness to get the remaining thickness under the counterbore and the minimum screw length.
holes.cskNote: Diameter = theoretical head diameter (ISO 7721) plus clearance. Measure the diameter at the surface.
holes.hexNote: Diameter is based on the head's across-corners size. A socket wrench needs a larger counterbore.
holes.lengthNote: Length measured under the head, including the washer. Thread run-out is not included in the engagement.
holes.lengthNoteCsk: Overall length of a countersunk screw (measured from the top of the head).

warn.noWasher: No washer in this size. Calculated without a washer.
warn.cskSmall: The countersink diameter is not larger than the hole diameter.
warn.cboreSmall: The counterbore diameter is not larger than the hole diameter.
warn.platePierced: The counterbore is deeper than the plate thickness.
warn.plateThin: Only a very thin layer of material remains under the counterbore.

holes.footer: Holes per ISO 273 (H12/H13/H14 tolerances), head dimensions per product standards. Counterbores include clearance, close to DIN 974-1. Check the standard if the drawing requires it.
